Kiwoom证券认为市场已经超卖，政府释放稳定基金可能入场的信号，有助于改善投资者情绪。但如果AI盈利担忧加剧、外资继续卖出，韩国综合指数可能进一步下探至4200—4300点。 4. 花旗韩国首席经济学家：根据海外投资者反馈，即使政府尚未真正投入稳定基金，只要明确表示必要时可以启动，也可能抑制部分卖空活动。这意味着政策的心理预期和实际资金投入同样值得关注。 5. 现代汽车证券：韩国股市需求要真正恢复，最终取决于两个关键因素：1. 外国投资者重新转为净买入韩国股票。2. 三星电子恢复股票回购。

items.title: CITIC Securities: Bank stocks remain driven by fund flows in near term
items.summary: CITIC Securities said the APEC meeting in Shenzhen called for deeper cross-border payment cooperation, while China Development Bank, Bank of China, China Construction Bank and Bank of Nanjing named the “six networks” as priority credit targets for the next phase. Passive inflows lifted bank stocks last week, with high-dividend large banks outperforming. Listed banks’ Q3 revenue and profit growth improved QoQ, while reported asset quality remained stable. items.title: China Securities: Defensive assets still offer strong allocation value
items.summary: China Securities said defensive assets remain attractive during a market bottoming process. Trading in major high-dividend sectors has picked up but is not crowded; it favors selective high-yield stocks with low institutional ownership and low positioning concentration, particularly banks, white goods, baijiu, home textiles, insurers, railways and highways, telecom operators, shipping and ports. If improving external conditions, strong market-stabilization policies and fresh inflows drive a rebound after the market bottoms, a broad rally could leave dividend stocks lagging temporarily, while small- and micro-cap stocks, technology and growth shares, and thematic plays may outperform.

items.title: CITIC Securities sees market rally broadening next year; diversifying exposure while focusing on leaders is a viable strategy
items.summary: Chinese regulators announced a package of market-stabilization measures on Nov. 22, including lowering margin financing requirements, advancing market-making on ChiNext and cutting fees. The measures target key market pressures amid overseas risks, volatility, net outflows of leveraged funds and a sharp ChiNext decline. Lower margin requirements will free up financing capacity and support liquidity, while market-making could attract incremental capital and cushion ChiNext volatility. The package also signals a commitment to stabilizing markets. CITIC Securities said the market correction has been brought forward and quality leaders in the middle of the barbell offer valuation opportunities. It expects the rally to broaden next year, making diversified exposure with a focus on leading stocks a viable strategy.

items.title: China International Capital Co expects gold to average around $4,300/oz in 2027
items.summary: China International Capital Co said a Fed rate-hike restart was the main headwind for gold prices in 2026. In 2027, easing energy inf and weak traditional demand may limit the case for sustained Fed hikes, while a monetary-policy turn could revive private-sector investment demand and support prices. Steady central-bank buying should also provide a floor. In its base case, with the upper bound of the federal funds rate rising to 4.25% and central-bank gold purchases holding at 1,000 tonnes a year, the firm expects COMEX gold to average around $4,300/oz in 2027. One additional 25-bp rate hike could add about $100-$200 to gold’s downside, its sensitivity analysis found.

items.title: China International Capital Co: Copper may find a floor near its $12,500/mt incentive price
items.summary: China International Capital Co expects modest mine supply growth, with scope for further downward revisions, while incremental AI demand should be significant. US tariffs are likely to sustain structural inventory tightness, keeping the market tight and supporting further price gains. However, slower revenue growth at large-model developers and tighter financing could delay AI data center construction, leaving demand temporarily below expectations and amplifying price volatility. Tighter macro liquidity could also weigh on prices, leaving copper vulnerable to a correction in a relatively conservative scenario. Copper prices may remain volatile this year, with a potential floor near $12,500/mt and a ceiling around $14,500/mt; the midpoint could rise further from 2026 levels.
